summary: Retain CSSOM/Web IDL behavior for direct style property assignments such as element.style.color = value.

semantics.css_parsing: assigned strings are parsed/serialized according to property grammar
semantics.invalid_value: generally does not become an arbitrary backend value; CSSOM behavior must be preserved
semantics.live_object: style declaration remains linked to the element's style attribute

caveats: A future native renderer may add narrower helper specializations for statically known supported properties, but this generic rule remains runtime.

tests.name: style object is live with style attribute
tests.expected_behavior: style attribute reflects CSSOM serialization of the declaration

tests.name: assignment is not arbitrary property bag semantics
tests.expected_behavior: returns serialized 1px value through canonical CSS property mapping
